fusions.name: Snap From Stillness
fusions.desc: You burst up to 4 tiles to the target and snap at everything in a 3-tile cone, dealing 12 damage and stunning what you catch for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Bankside Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.8 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Settled Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Haunches
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
